discription: A rich and warm pad sound created with two slightly detuned sawtooth oscillators, enveloped by a long ADSR curve for sustained textures.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.5, decay=0.8, sustain=0.7, release=2.0, detuneAmount=0.005; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var detuneFreq = freq * (1 + detuneAmount); var osc1 = Saw.ar(freq); var osc2 = Saw.ar(detuneFreq); sig = (osc1 + osc2) * 0.5 * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
